explicitLandedPortAndSuccessorCommits.message:
feat: land individual enemy face overlays on Dev

- from Prod 907d5cd (Codex session 01a115c2, card Persistent random face overlays): grunts, ogres and knights get a persistent random face, saved with the edict
- conflicts resolved against Dev: rend-veil records, slope halves, cheat powers, vision program key; faces merged into index.json v26 by variant
- skin identity digests leave faces out (the enemy_face suites check them); classifier rule for enemy_face.js; docs index regenerated
- browser: ogre, grunt and knight drawn with faces, 23 seeds kept through save and load, no GL errors

feat: replace monster closet arrivals with Rend the Veil

Brought from Prod (3f2084c, by Brian, 7 Oct) for card [E1]: teleported
monsters used a brief red/blue stretch; now the supplied ritual (runes and a
black-and-purple warp) plays and the monster waits until Focus.

Conflicts with Dev resolved (imports, the present pass now runs for the
veil's optics, the power-up visions and the water ripples alike); the face
overlay lines from 907d5cd, another card's work, are left out. Rend the Veil
tests 7/7 and 10/10; full suite: only the failures Dev already had. Browser
on E1M2: runes and warp through Focus, no stretch.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat: give Armagon a menacing photographic boss skin

- Problem: the generated boss lacked a strong character and its images needed the runtime WebP92 standard.
- Change: fit Shambler-guided flesh and mechanical artwork to the native body and legs, rebake normals, and reconstruct verified flat flash heights after decoding.
- Outcome: the tooth-filled face and heavy machinery map across all 98 paired poses; independent asset, runtime, GPU and provenance checks pass.
- Preserve: native model identities, UVs, animation, flash semantics and all other enemy designs.

feat: animate Lava Man skin and match native lava heat

- Problem: the delivered effect deformed the mesh instead of making the skin look internally twisted, and the creature needed separate heat shimmer with native lava HDR color.
- Change: flow all skin channels over unchanged native geometry through actor-owned material clones, add bounded actor sources to the existing heat pass, and calibrate only hot HDR pigment against actual native lava.
- Outcome: public native CPU and real GPU tests verify skin motion, canonical geometry, native-lava intensity/color, separate heat animation, foreground occlusion and existing pool preservation.
- Preserve: original artwork/model/gameplay, Classic behavior, shared HDR pulse and compositor, bounded resources, parked natural-surface/rock-edge work and the enforced exact-index build gate.

feat: land the main checkout's water, vision and cloak work and its clean-up

- Owner's water optics: pool depth from real undersides, caustics in the compositor, E1M2 look

- Quad and power vision refinements; remote Ring of Shadows body frames (opt-in capability)

- Owner's deletions of old docs, evidence and loose images, keeping files tests or code read

- Gremlin and Eel keep Dev's published art; world-texture work held for its owner
